block.description:
Use the `temporalcloud` provider to interact with resources supported by [Temporal Cloud](https://temporal.io/cloud).

Use the navigation to the left to learn about the available resources supported by this provider.

## Provider Configuration

Credentials for Temporal Cloud can be provided by adding an `api_key` property or by setting the environment variable `TEMPORAL_CLOUD_API_KEY`.
You can generate an API key for Temporal Cloud by following [these instructions](https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/api-keys).

!> Hard-coded credentials are not recommended in any Terraform configuration and should not be committed
in version control. We recommend passing credentials to this provider via environment variables.

codec_server.description: A codec server is used by the Temporal Cloud UI to decode payloads for all users interacting with this namespace, even if the workflow history itself is encrypted.

connectivity_rule_ids.description: The IDs of the connectivity rules for this namespace.

created_time.description: The date and time when the namespace was created.

custom_search_attributes.description: The custom search attributes to use for the namespace.

grpc_address.description: The gRPC hostport address that the temporal workers, clients and tctl connect to.

id.description: The unique identifier of the namespace across all Temporal Cloud tenants.

last_modified_time.description: The date and time when the namespace was last modified. Will not be set if the namespace has never been modified.

actions_per_second_limit.description: The number of actions per second (APS) that is currently allowed for the namespace. The namespace may be throttled if its APS exceeds the limit.

limits.description: The limits set on the namespace currently.

enable_delete_protection.description: If true, delete protection is enabled for the namespace. This means that the namespace cannot be deleted until this is set to false.

namespace_lifecycle.description: The lifecycle settings for the namespace.

allowed_principal_arns.description: The list of principal arns that are allowed to access the namespace on the private link.

vpc_endpoint_service_names.description: The list of vpc endpoint service names that are associated with the namespace.

aws_private_link_info.description: The AWS PrivateLink info. This will only be set for namespaces whose cloud provider is AWS.

region.description: The id of the region where the private connectivity applies.

private_connectivities.description: The private connectivities for the namespace, if any.

regions.description: The list of regions that this namespace is available in. If more than one region is specified, this namespace is a Multi-region Namespace, which is currently unsupported by the Terraform provider.

retention_days.description: The number of days to retain workflow history. Any changes to the retention period will be applied to all new running workflows.

state.description: The current state of the namespace.

block.description: Fetches details about all Namespaces.

namespace_id.description: The target cloud namespace to route requests to. Namespace is in same account as the endpoint.

task_queue.description: The task queue on the cloud namespace to route requests to.

worker_target.description: The target spec for routing nexus requests to a specific cloud namespace worker.
